faqs.question: What age groups do you accept, and is previous experience required?
faqs.answer: We accept students from ages 6 to 18, grouped into age-appropriate cohorts. No previous modeling, acting, or photography experience is required; our classes are designed to guide beginners to advanced portfolio builders while developing confidence.

faqs.question: What subjects are taught, and how long does the programme run?
faqs.answer: The curriculum spans six core creative areas: Fashion & Modeling, Acting & Performance, Photography, Fashion Design & Styling, Creative Direction, and Confidence & Communication. The standard programme is 12 weeks long (one academic term).

faqs.question: Where are classes held, what is the timetable, and what is the dress code?
faqs.answer: Classes are conducted at our elite studio campuses in London and Vienna, mostly on weekends. Timetables are sent post-acceptance. Students are asked to wear simple monochrome black clothing to ensure a clean, professional aesthetic on camera.

faqs.question: Are professional photoshoots, showcase runway events, and casting opportunities included?
faqs.answer: Yes, all term students participate in professional studio photoshoots to build their portfolios and perform in our graduate runway showcase. We share candidate portfolios with partnered casting scouts and model agencies.

faqs.question: Can tuition be paid in instalments, and what are the policies for missed classes and refunds?
faqs.answer: Yes, secure monthly instalment options are available. If a student misses a class, they are provided with makeup guides or can join another cohort. Term deposits are refundable up to 14 days before classes start, after which tuition is non-refundable.

faqs.question: How do you manage photography/video release and student safeguarding?
faqs.answer: Safeguarding is our primary commitment. All coaches are fully vetted and DBS-checked. Parents must sign media and medical consent releases during registration. Captured media is used strictly for academic evaluation and student portfolios.

faqs.question: Do graduates receive certificates, and can students join after the term has started?
faqs.answer: Yes, graduates with satisfactory attendance receive a Marse Academy Certificate of Completion. Late joining is permitted up to week two, subject to seat availability, with a prorated tuition setup.

aboutSettings.heroLead: MARSE Academy of Fashion & Arts is a premium London-based creative institution. We merge high fashion, visual arts, and performance to build elite skills and personal confidence in young minds.
aboutSettings.storyText1: Founded in London, MARSE Academy was born out of a desire to create a safe, aspirational space for young creative minds. Julia Marse recognized that traditional creative education was fragmented; modeling was taught separately from acting, and photography was rarely integrated with creative styling or confidence training.
aboutSettings.storyText2: We built MARSE Academy as a multidisciplinary hub where young people don't just learn skills—they collaborate on real production sets, direct photoshoots, curate sustainable fashion collections, and present themselves to the world with power and elegance.
aboutSettings.storyQuote: We do not only train models and actors; we nurture future leaders, creative directors, and confident communicators who dare to shape the cultural landscape.
aboutSettings.missionText: To develop confident, creative, and highly disciplined young people. While we provide elite industry-grade training in fashion and modeling, our ultimate mission is to build character, resilience, and creative leaders. We prepare students for life, giving them communication skills, posture, set etiquette, and teamwork capabilities that serve them in any career.
aboutSettings.founderTitle: International Fashion Photographer, Creative Director & Educator
aboutSettings.founderBio1: Julia Marse is an acclaimed international fashion photographer, creative director, studio owner, and passionate educator. With over a decade of experience shooting for luxury brands and fashion magazines, Julia founded MARSE Academy to pass down set etiquette, photography techniques, and styling workflows to the next generation.
aboutSettings.founderBio2: Under her creative direction, students get the unique opportunity to shoot on high-end production sets, build premium portfolios, and learn directly from active industry experts.
aboutSettings.safeguardingText: Student welfare is our absolute priority. MARSE Academy is committed to providing a safe, supportive, and respectful environment. All staff are fully vetted (DBS cleared), and we implement strict media consent protocols, transparent chaperone policies, and strict codes of conduct to ensure complete safety and peace of mind for parents.
